test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Prakash can do a piece of work in 18 days. If Mukesh works twice as fast as Prakash, how long would it take to finish the work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

Prakash can do a piece of work in 18 days.

Mukesh works twice as fast as Prakash.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of Prakash = 1 work / 18 days

Work rate of Mukesh = 2 × (1 work / 18 days)

Total work rate when working together = Work rate of Prakash + Work rate of Mukesh

**Calculation:**

Work rate of Prakash = 1/18

Work rate of Mukesh = 2 × (1/18) = 2/18 = 1/9

Total work rate when working together = 1/18 + 1/9

⇒ Total work rate = 1/18 + 2/18

⇒ Total work rate = 3/18

⇒ Total work rate = 1/6

⇒ Time to complete the work when working together = 1 / (Total work rate)

⇒ Time = 1 / (1/6)

⇒ Time = 6 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
